requirements.text: An implementation specification consistent with the approved MDD is prepared before implementation starts and approved by the Model Owner.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §4.1.

requirements.text: The implementation specification defines the production source field and lineage of every input variable and identifies any difference between development and production data sources.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §4.2.

requirements.text: The implementation specification defines every transformation, missing value and outlier treatment, formula, coefficient, lookup table, rating scale mapping, floor, cap and override rule, with precision and rounding conventions.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §4.3.

requirements.text: The implementation specification includes test cases with expected outputs produced with the development code, covering typical cases, boundary values, missing and invalid inputs and every segment and grade.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §4.4.

requirements.text: Development and production code are held in an approved version control system, and every version used for reported or production outputs is tagged and retrievable.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §5.1.

requirements.text: The MDD records the development code version, RDS version and parameter set that produced the reported results.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §5.2.

requirements.text: Changes to production code follow change management with four-eyes code review by a person other than the author and documented approval before deployment.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §5.3.

requirements.text: Parameter tables (coefficients, scorecard points, calibration mappings, master scale) are version controlled, access restricted and changed only through change management.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §5.4.

requirements.text: Model developers do not have write access to the production environment of the model.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §5.5.

requirements.text: The implementation is tested before go-live by a tester independent of the production code author and, for Tier 1 models, independent of the model development team.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §6.1.

requirements.text: Implementation testing covers all specified test cases, input data mapping and transformations, handling of missing, invalid and boundary values, and outputs for every segment.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §6.2.

requirements.text: Test plan, cases, results and defects are documented in a test report, and all defects affecting model outputs are resolved and retested before go-live.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §6.3.

requirements.text: A parallel run is performed before a new or materially changed Tier 1 model or IRB model is used for decisions or regulatory reporting.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §7.1.

requirements.text: The parallel run covers at least one full production cycle and three monthly reference dates for Tier 1 models, and one monthly reference date for Tier 2 models.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §7.2.

requirements.text: Parallel run results are analysed and documented, including migration between old and new outputs, impact on key risk measures and operational issues.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §7.3.

requirements.text: Production outputs are reconciled at record level with development code outputs on identical input data covering the full RDS or at least 10,000 records per segment.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §8.1.

requirements.text: Reconciliation meets predefined tolerances: continuous outputs within 10^-6 absolute or 0.01% relative difference, categorical outputs such as rating grade identical for all records.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §8.2.

requirements.text: All reconciliation differences outside tolerance are investigated and explained, and unexplained differences block go-live.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §8.3.

requirements.text: The lineage of development data and production input data is compared and the effect of any difference on model outputs is quantified.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §8.4.

requirements.text: Model outputs are reconciled with the downstream systems consuming them at go-live and at least annually thereafter.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §8.5.

requirements.text: User acceptance testing by model user representatives confirms that the implemented model supports its intended use, outputs are presented correctly and override processes function as designed.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §9.1.

requirements.text: UAT results are documented and signed off by the Model Owner and the head of the principal user function before go-live.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §9.2.

requirements.text: The model is used in production only after implementation testing, reconciliation, parallel run where required and UAT are completed and the model is approved for use under MRM-POL-001.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §10.1.

requirements.text: Production input data is subject to completeness and validity checks applying the DQ rules of MRM-STD-022.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §10.2.

requirements.text: Production controls ensure each run uses the approved code and parameter version and log every run with reference date, input data version and code version.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §10.2.

requirements.text: Manual reruns, manual output adjustments and fallback procedures are documented, authorised and logged.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §10.3.

requirements.text: Model outputs used for regulatory reporting are retained with the input data and code version used to produce them.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to models whose outputs are used for regulatory or risk reporting.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §10.4.

requirements.text: The production code is consistent with the MDD and implementation specification, and any difference is treated as a defect or submitted as a model change under MRM-STD-050.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §11.1.

requirements.text: The Model Owner confirms consistency between production code, implementation specification and MDD after each change and at least annually.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §11.2.

requirements.text: Emergency changes deployed before completion of all tests are approved by the Model Owner and Model Risk Management and the outstanding tests are completed within 30 calendar days.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (MRM-STD-030 v2.0), §13.2.
